Sat down with Sarah Chieng at Cerebras Supernova to talk chips.

Etched going from nothing to shipping a rack to Jane Street in a couple years is super sick.

But the bigger point is that everyone in inference hardware is making different bets.

Some are trying to make the cheapest tokens possible.

Others are trying to be the fastest.

NVIDIA is really good at throughput and you can't get that much better there.

But you can get a lot better on speed.

Cerebras is a yapper.

Dark Patterns: How They Are Used and Regulated on the AI-Driven Web, with Jon Fernandez, Etched, Inc.

Monday, Sept. 14, 2026 | 12 – 1 p.m. | King Hall, Room 1301 | MCLE Credits Available | No Registration Fee

But the harms they cause go beyond nudging consumers to buy something they don’t want or need; these designs can coax people into divulging deeply private information that can be used against them.
